title: Unit tests for apply-schema endpoint
description: Write automated unit tests to verify the apply-schema backend endpoint, no-drops safety check, and frontend integration work correctly.
acceptanceCriteria: Unit tests verify apply-schema executes DDL successfully
Unit tests verify no-drops safety check rejects DROP statements
Unit tests verify error handling for DDL failures

Backend apply-schema.test.ts: 24/24 passed — DDL execution, transaction (BEGIN/COMMIT), statement_timeout, search_path parameterisation, DROP/TRUNCATE/DELETE rejection, ALTER COLUMN/MODIFY COLUMN/RENAME/DROP CONSTRAINT rejection, ADD CONSTRAINT/ADD COLUMN allowance, rollback on execution failure, descriptive error responses

Frontend DdlPreview.test.tsx: 12/12 passed — confirmation checkbox gating, applyDDL called with confirm=true and /api/apply-schema, success/error message display, no applyDDL without confirmation, null connection guard
